title: Purpose boundary lab
description: Choose a processing purpose, proposed data package, and consent state. The policy engine shows which fields can cross the boundary and why.

purposes.label: Complete a purchase
purposes.detail: Fulfill an order, prevent duplicate payment, and preserve accounting evidence.

purposes.label: Personalize recommendations
purposes.detail: Use recent product interactions to rank a customer-specific catalog.

purposes.label: Investigate payment fraud
purposes.detail: Detect suspicious transactions while limiting reuse for unrelated profiling.

packages.label: Purpose minimum
packages.detail: Only the fields the selected workflow was designed to consume.

packages.label: Growth convenience
packages.detail: Adds behavioral and location fields because they may be useful later.

packages.label: Raw customer profile
packages.detail: Moves the full profile, including highly sensitive fields, into the workflow.

notice: A production policy must use reviewed purposes, lawful bases, field classifications, and retention rules. This fixture teaches the decision shape, not legal advice.
